text:
ana: heads-up: post-deploy synthetic for prefill in eu-west showed intermittent 1/5 fails right after the 01:00 deployment. not huge but flaky and tracked by the deadman. tagging eng-releases.

deploy-bot: AUTO: postdeploy-synth eu-west prefill: 1/5 failures in 10m window. canary cohort: 5%. no rollback triggered. logs: /deploy/logs/1777001234/eu-west.

sre-bot: initial sampler: single failure shows p95 spike to 730ms, downstream tokenization had a 900ms outlier. most hosts normal. suspect hysteresis in prefill warmup when traffic ramps from 0->small.

kevin: could be the rolling prefill strategy not priming enough instances at low canary %. we recently tightened prefills to reduce cost. maybe too aggressive.

ops-bot: checking recent agent deploy flags: prefill_max_concurrent=2 for canary groups. previous stable was 4. that change landed yesterday in config-batch.

ana: (typo) ana: i can temporarily revert that flag for this rollout to see if it clears. recommend holding rollout at 0% until we verify.

ana: pausing rollout and reverting prefill_max_concurrent -> 4 for canary IG.

deploy-bot: ACTION: rollout paused by ana. canary set to 0%. deployment variables updated.

sre-bot: re-run synthetic runner after config change (interval 10s, 5 probes).

(90s)

sre-bot: synthetic runner: 5/5 success, p95 48ms. no repeats of deadman.

kevin: that matches hypothesis. lowering prefill concurrency saved cost but introduced warmup hysteresis at very low traffic.

ana: decision: do not rollback. plan: 1) keep reverted config for remainder of rollout, 2) create a short-lived flag matrix for prefill concurrency based on canary cohort (min 4 at 0-10%), 3) eng-runtime to propose cost/latency tradeoffs.

sre-bot: added runbook note: when tuning prefill/concurrency, include a synthetic stress test at low-traffic bands to catch hysteresis.

kevin: creating ticket ENGR-1427 to track permanent fix and metricized rollout for future changes.

ana: release note blurb: "Post-deploy: transient prefill warmup hysteresis in eu-west caused a single synthetic failure at 1% canary after recent tuning. Mitigated by reverting prefill concurrency; rollout resumed. No customer impact."

deploy-bot: AUTO: postdeploy-synth resolved. canary resumed at 5%.

ana: closing thread after 30m of stable synthetics. thanks.
